children: NACCO Industries reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $80.49M, up 5.1% from the prior-year quarter, while net income declined 17.7% to $10.91M and diluted EPS fell 19.1% to $1.44. Contract Mining growth supported revenue, while results in Minerals and Royalties were lower.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.

Contract Mining revenue excluding reimbursable costs rose 75% in the quarter, driven by a new Florida dragline contract and equipment sales. The multi-year Florida contract ramped up, while Arizona quarry operations began in early October under a decade-long agreement.
Utility Coal operating profit improved year over year, supported by higher coal prices and lower inventory impairments. Management also noted customer payment delays at MLMC.
Minerals and Royalties revenue declined 34% amid lower gas revenue and commodity-price fluctuations. Management expects lower results in 2026, with meaningful earnings continuing in 2027.
Management expects 2026 operating profit to be comparable to 2025 and further improvement in 2027, supported by Contract Mining and Mitigation Resources expansion.
